title: Buy Gifts Online in Pakistan Without the 'I Panicked and Bought a Mug' Regret
author: Omar Farooq
authorBio: Founder of BazaarNow. Has given and received approximately 47 mugs in his lifetime. Keeps exactly 2. The other 45 are in a cupboard that has not been opened since 2019. Wrote this guide so you don't become the person whose gift ends up in someone else's Unopened Cupboard.
excerpt: Birthdays, Eid, weddings, 'just because' — here's how to buy gifts online in Pakistan that people actually want, with free delivery and no last-minute panic.

sections.content: The average Pakistani receives 8-12 gifts per year. Three of them are mugs. Two are scented candles they will never light. One is a wallet that is still in its box. And maybe — if they're lucky — one is something they actually wanted. This post is about being the person who gives that one. Not the mug person. The mug person is fine. The mug person means well. But the mug person is not you. Not after today.

sections.title: The Gift Buying Rules
items: If the recipient didn't ask for it by name and you don't know their size — don't buy clothes, shoes, or jewellery. These are the most-returned gift categories
Gadgets, accessories, and home decor are the safest online gift purchases — no sizing, no 'will this match their couch' anxiety
Order at least 5-7 days before the event. Standard delivery is 2-4 working days. Add buffer. The courier is not your emergency contact
BazaarNow has 1,964 products with free delivery. Use the search bar with the recipient's interest (e.g., 'watch,' 'handbag,' 'earbuds') to find gift ideas
Include a gift note in your WhatsApp order message. Write something personal. Not 'Happy Birthday.' That's a mug-level note

sections.text: The 5 gift categories where you literally cannot go wrong
1. Wireless earbuds — the universal 'I respect you' gift

sections.content: Everyone uses earbuds. The person who says they don't need earbuds is the person who most needs earbuds. At Rs. 3,000-5,000, a good pair of wireless earbuds says 'I value your auditory experience' without saying 'I spent my entire salary on this.' It's the perfect gift tier — thoughtful but not intimidating. BazaarNow has 30+ earbud options. Pick the ones with Bluetooth 5.3 or newer. The technology difference between 5.0 and 5.3 is noticeable. The gift recipient might not know why their earbuds work better. They'll just know they do.

sections.text: 2. Handbags — the gift that says 'I pay attention'

sections.content: A handbag is personal. That's precisely why it's a great gift — it shows you noticed what kind of bag they carry. Tote person? Buy a tote. Crossbody person? Buy a crossbody. Clutch-at-weddings person? You know what to do. Don't buy a style they never use just because it looked good in the photo. That's how gifts become cupboard residents. We wrote a [full guide to buying handbags online](/blog/buy-handbags-online-pakistan). Read it before you order. The 7-day return window means if you get the style wrong, they can exchange it. (Don't tell them you planned for that possibility. It ruins the illusion of thoughtfulness. But do plan for it.)

sections.text: 3. Smartwatches — the 'you're an adult now' gift

sections.content: A smartwatch at Rs. 8,000-12,000 is the gift that says 'I take you seriously.' It has health tracking, notifications, and a screen that lights up when you raise your wrist — which is still, somehow, delightful every single time. (I've had mine for 2 years. The wrist-raise-to-wake still brings me joy. Simple pleasures. Simple man.) Buy a smartwatch for: a parent who should monitor their steps, a sibling who just started their first job, a spouse who keeps missing notifications because their phone is permanently on silent. (It's always on silent. It has been on silent since 2022. The smartwatch will buzz on their wrist. They will look. This is progress.)

sections.text: 4. Skincare and beauty sets — the gift of self-care

sections.content: A skincare set at Rs. 2,000-4,000 is the gift that says 'you deserve 20 minutes of peace.' Look for sets labeled 'organic,' 'vitamin C,' or 'hyaluronic acid' — these ingredients are universally appreciated and rarely cause skin reactions. Avoid anything with 'lightening' or 'bleaching' in the name unless you know the recipient specifically uses those products. Gifting skincare is like gifting a haircut — it's either perfect or disastrous. Err on the side of gentle, natural, universally-liked formulations. Our Beauty category has 397 products. Filter by 'skincare' when searching.

sections.text: 5. Home decor — the 'your house is your personality' gift

sections.content: Wall art, decorative vases, LED night lamps, Islamic calligraphy frames — home decor says 'I thought about your space.' It's safer than clothes (no size issues) and more interesting than gift vouchers. Avoid anything larger than 50cm unless you've seen their walls and know there's space. The 'I bought you a giant wall clock' gift is memorable. Not always in a good way. BazaarNow's Home & Living category has 477 products. Search 'wall art,' 'decor,' or 'lamp' for inspiration.

sections.text: The timing problem that ruins every gift

sections.content: Here's what happens every time: you remember the birthday is tomorrow. You order a gift with express 'same-day' delivery from a store you've never used before. The gift arrives late. Or it's the wrong thing. Or the store was fake and now you're out Rs. 3,000 and still need a gift. Panic-gifting is the leading cause of mug purchases. (Not a real statistic. But it feels real. You know it's real. I know it's real. The mug industry knows it's real.)

The fix: keep a 'gift stash.' Buy 2-3 generic-but-nice items when there's no occasion. Store them. When someone's birthday surprises you, you reach into the stash. You wrap it. You are a hero who planned ahead. The recipient will never know the gift was purchased 6 weeks ago and lived in your cupboard. This is not deception. This is logistics. (My current stash: two smartwatches, one skincare set, and a leather wallet. Total cost: Rs. 12,000. Peace of mind when I forgot my nephew's birthday: priceless. He got the wallet. He loved it. He doesn't need to know about the stash.)

sections.text: Eid gifts — the gift-giving Olympics of Pakistan

sections.content: Eid involves giving gifts to: parents, siblings, cousins (close ones), cousins (the ones your mom insists on), in-laws, children of all of the above, and sometimes the neighbor who brought seviyan last year. That's 10-15 gifts. The budget is finite. The expectations are not. Here's the strategy: tier your gifts. Rs. 3,000-5,000 for immediate family. Rs. 1,000-2,000 for close cousins and in-laws. Rs. 500-1,000 for children and extended family. Gadgets for siblings. Accessories for parents. Toys for kids. The key is ordering 2-3 weeks before Eid. Not 3 days before. Three days before Eid is when every courier in Pakistan is overwhelmed and your package will arrive on the 4th day of Eid, by which point everyone has already asked 'mera gift kidhar hai' at least twice.

You need them in less than 3 days. Standard delivery is 2-4 working days. During peak seasons (Eid, wedding season in December), add 2 extra days. If the event is this weekend and it's already Thursday — go to the physical market. Touch the products. Buy something. Wrap it in the car. Show up. Smile. Nobody needs to know you bought it 40 minutes ago. The gift stash method would have prevented this entire scenario. Learn from this. Start the stash. Be better next time.

Also: don't buy personalized gifts online from an unfamiliar store. Custom-engraved watch? Custom-printed t-shirt with an inside joke? These require trust in the seller's quality. If you haven't ordered from them before, don't make a personalized item the test order. Buy something standard first. Verify they deliver. Then get the custom piece for the next gift. Personalized gifts are the final boss of online shopping. Don't start with the final boss.

items.q: What's the best gift to buy online for someone who has everything?
items.a: Wireless earbuds or a smartwatch. Even people who 'have everything' rarely have good earbuds. The ones that came with their phone don't count. If they already have premium earbuds, go for a leather wallet or a skincare set. Gadgets and self-care are the two categories that work when clothes and accessories feel risky.

We'll include it with the delivery. If you want us to gift-wrap or add a card, mention that too. We'll try our best.

Refunds go back to the original payment method. You don't need to tell them you bought it online with a backup return plan. That's between us.

items.q: Can I send a gift directly to the recipient's address?
items.a: Yes. When filling out the customer info at checkout, use the recipient's name, phone number, and address instead of your own. The delivery rider will call them before arriving. If it's a surprise, tell the recipient to expect a package but don't reveal what it is. The rider won't spoil the surprise. They don't know what's in the box either.

items.q: How early should I order before Eid or a wedding?
items.a: 2-3 weeks before Eid. 2 weeks before a wedding. 1 week before a birthday. This accounts for delivery time + potential exchanges + the universal truth that couriers get slower during peak seasons. The extra buffer is not paranoia. It's pattern recognition. I've seen the delivery data. The week before Eid is chaos. Plan accordingly.

items.q: Do you deliver gifts to all cities in Pakistan?
items.a: 100+ cities. Free delivery. The checkout page has a dropdown with all cities we serve. If the recipient lives in a remote area, WhatsApp us first to confirm delivery. We'll check with our courier partner. 2-4 working days for most cities. Some remote areas take 5-7 days. We'll tell you upfront before you order.

sections.content: Gift-giving in Pakistan is not just a transaction. It's a social contract. The right gift strengthens relationships. The wrong gift becomes a cupboard resident — seen but never used, remembered but never appreciated. Buy with COD. Keep a gift stash. Order 2 weeks early. And for the love of everything, stop buying mugs. BazaarNow has 1,964 alternatives. Free delivery to 100+ cities. 5% off on advance payment. Start your gift stash today. Your future self — the one who forgot their cousin's wedding until 3 days before — will thank you.
